newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian market rates flat in Wednesday's trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian market rates flat in Wednesday's trade.

text.p: Croatian interbank call money rates remained mostly unchanged on Wednesday, dealers said, and the trend of mostly call money loans being granted continued.
"For the first time in a while we have had some money left over on the supply side," a dealer told Reuters.
Fresh loans totalled 31 million kuna out of which all but one were call money loans granted at a steady 10.5 percent rate. A single one-week loan was granted at nine percent.
Some ten million kuna was left on the supply side.
Tuesday's overnight trade totalled 156 million kuna with one bank seeking funds to cover its shortfalls and the rest being used by banks to maintain their mandatory reserves.
The dealer said the main reason there was more overnight trade that usual was that funds were granted at a lower rate than usual. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
